run_test_long_term_list_actions: run the test_long_term script with --list to print all available locomotion actions for subject S1
run_test_long_term_generate_all: run the test_long_term script with no arguments to generate and render animations for all subjects and actions
run_test_long_term_specific_action: run the test_long_term script with an action name to generate and render that specific animation interactively
run_test_long_term_save_output: run the test_long_term script with an action name and output path to save the rendered animation to a file
review_PoseNetworkLongTerm_generate_moti: review the PoseNetworkLongTerm model and how generate_motion creates animation from annotated splines and dataset data
